plaza_mayor.name: Plaza Mayor de Lima
plaza_mayor.tip: Start here early to see the square before tour groups arrive. Watch your belongings in crowds.

cathedral.name: Cathedral of Lima
cathedral.price_text: Small entry fee · check on the day
cathedral.hours: Generally open daily, shorter hours on Sunday
cathedral.tip: Entry includes the cathedral and its museum. Dress modestly and keep quiet during services.

san_francisco.name: Monastery of San Francisco
san_francisco.price_text: Modest entry fee · check on the day
san_francisco.hours: Daily, roughly 09:00–17:00 · check on the day
san_francisco.tip: The catacombs tour is the highlight. Book a guided slot and skip the midday queue.

huaca_pucllana.name: Huaca Pucllana
huaca_pucllana.price_text: Entry fee · check on the day · night visits cost more
huaca_pucllana.hours: Day visits and some evening slots · check on the day
huaca_pucllana.tip: Go with a guide; the adobe pyramid makes more sense with the story. Evening visits are atmospheric.
huaca_pucllana.best: Late afternoon or an evening slot

pachacamac.name: Pachacamac
pachacamac.price_text: Entry fee plus museum · check on the day
pachacamac.hours: Daytime only · check on the day
pachacamac.tip: It is a large dusty site south of the city. Bring water, a hat and sunblock.

larco_museum.name: Larco Museum
larco_museum.price_text: Entry fee · check on the day
larco_museum.hours: Daily, roughly 09:00–22:00 · check on the day
larco_museum.tip: The erotic pottery gallery and the storage rooms are worth the extra time. The garden café is a calm break.
larco_museum.best: Late afternoon, then dinner in the café

government_palace.name: Government Palace
government_palace.price_text: Exterior free · interior visits by arrangement
government_palace.hours: View from the square any time · interior check on the day
government_palace.tip: You usually see it from outside. The changing of the guard is a short, free spectacle; check the day.
government_palace.best: Midday for the guard change, if scheduled

archbishops_palace.name: Archbishop's Palace of Lima
archbishops_palace.tip: Look up at the carved wooden balconies. It is a quick photo stop next to the cathedral.

bridge_of_sighs.name: Bridge of Sighs, Lima
bridge_of_sighs.tip: Walk here from the Plaza Mayor through the old streets. Go in daylight; the area is quieter at night.

ceviche.name: Ceviche lunch
ceviche.tip: Lima eats ceviche at lunch. Pick a busy place and order fresh fish of the day.

monumental.name: Estadio Monumental U
monumental.price_text: Match tickets vary · check on the day
monumental.hours: Match days only · check on the day
monumental.tip: Only worth it for a football match. Buy tickets from official channels and arrange transport back.

estadio_nacional.name: Estadio Nacional del Peru
estadio_nacional.price_text: Event tickets vary · check on the day
estadio_nacional.hours: Event days only · check on the day
estadio_nacional.tip: Hosts big matches and concerts. Check the event calendar before you plan a visit.

huaca_huallamarca.name: Huaca Huallamarca
huaca_huallamarca.price_text: Small entry fee · check on the day
huaca_huallamarca.tip: A small pyramid in the middle of San Isidro. A quick stop if you are nearby.

mali.name: Lima Art Museum (MALI)
mali.price_text: Entry fee · check on the day · free slots sometimes
mali.hours: Closed some weekdays · check on the day
mali.tip: Check opening days before you go. The building and courtyard are as good as the art.

torre_tagle.name: Torre Tagle Palace
torre_tagle.tip: Admire the carved stone facade from the street. Interior access is limited; check on the day.

miraflores_malecon.name: Malecón and cliff walk, Miraflores
miraflores_malecon.tip: Walk the clifftop path from the lighthouse toward the parks. Watch for paragliders overhead.

barranco_walk.name: Barranco neighbourhood walk
barranco_walk.hours: Any time · livelier in the evening
barranco_walk.tip: Wander the streets around the Bridge of Sighs. Go in daylight first, then return for bars at night.

surquillo_market.name: Mercado N° 1 de Surquillo
surquillo_market.hours: Morning to early afternoon · check on the day
surquillo_market.tip: Go before noon for fruit, juice and cheap local lunches. Keep valuables close.

paragliding.name: Paragliding over the Costa Verde
paragliding.tip: Flights depend on wind. Book with an established operator and check what insurance is included.

barranco_bars.name: Barranco nightlife
barranco_bars.tip: Start with a pisco sour and stay in the main streets. Use a taxi app to get back.

costa_verde_beach.name: Costa Verde beaches
costa_verde_beach.tip: The water is cold and the surf strong. Check conditions and swim only where locals do.

city_tour.name: Centro Histórico walking tour
city_tour.price_text: Free tours tip-based · paid tours ≈ PEN 40–80
city_tour.tip: A guide makes the colonial history click. Confirm the meeting point and tip expectations.

pisco_tasting.name: Pisco sour tasting
pisco_tasting.tip: Try a bar that explains the grape varieties. Eat something first.
